title: Card - Services
description: Centred services card shell with a reusable animated accent border, replaceable icon well, tick list, and inline CTA. Non-expressible structural properties (position, overflow, align-items, max-inline-size, text-align, transform-origin, the content/list/cta layout, the accent-gradient bar) and the hover state stay in src/scss/components.scss — a bare &:hover in this css field is silently dropped, same class of bug as @media/@supports stripping.
